$comment: #EXP-1456 (owner 2026-10-30): WHERE AN INBOX ROW OPENS ×4, the inbox row tap and the push tap alike. inboxRowTarget(row): a row with `issueId` opens its ISSUE (an `agent_message` about an issue opens that issue's Results face, EXP-933; every other issue row the issue). An issue-less row (`agent_message`, `session_blocked`) with `sessionId` opens THAT SESSION, whatever its type: an Assistant's or team agent's decision (#EXP-1439: question or plan card, `agent_message` titled `copy.decisionPush` of agent-settings.json), an @mention in a conversation (EXP-1291), a wall (EXP-980). An issue-less row without a session (an agent's broadcast, a device share removal, a pruned session) opens NOTHING. Any other issue-less type is not listed. Every tap marks the row read first. sessionTarget(session, viewerId): where a session opens, the S-3 inter-session rule (web lib/session-back.ts): the VIEWER's OWN agent CONVERSATION ROOT (its root is itself, carries `agentId`, and `userId` = the viewer) opens the AGENT's page (its channel: the waiting question or plan sits in its dock); a thread ROOT opens the THREAD; a thread's CHILD opens inside its thread (`threadId` + `sessionId`); anything else under an agent (a teammate's conversation, a child of a conversation) opens AS A SESSION on its own screen. `rootId` null = the row is its own root. A session the client has not synced opens the session route's not-found state, never nothing. Mirrors: TS src/inbox-route.ts, desktop `domain::inbox_route`, iOS ExpCore `InboxRoute.swift`, Android `domain/InboxRoute.kt`.
